request.description:
Single endpoint handling all progress views and filters for Parents (Figma Nodes 32917:6566, 32917:7202, 32917:7790).

Filters via \	ab\ query param:
- \	ab=week\: This Week view (Mental Performance score, Weekly Goal Progress, Daily Habits, Training Consistency)
- \	ab=month\: This Month view (Daily scores, Monthly Progress breakdown, Summary Stats)
- \	ab=academy\: Academy view (Curriculum week, completedPhase, runningPhase, Mindset Development, Achievements)
- (No tab): Returns all 3 views unified.
